import Spec
import I5hLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result tuwunel_kernel tuwunel_kernel.Spec I5hLib

namespace tuwunel_kernel.Solution

set_option maxHeartbeats 400000
set_option Elab.async false

@[simp] theorem deref_eq_slice {Element : Type} (value : alloc.vec.Vec Element) :
    value.deref = value.slice := by
  simp [alloc.vec.Vec.deref, alloc.vec.Vec.val]

def countAt (snapshot : Snapshot) (index : Usize) : Int :=
  ((snapshot.pdus.val[index.val]?).map (fun record => record.count.val)).getD 0

def eventAt (snapshot : Snapshot) (index : Usize) : U64 :=
  ((snapshot.pdus.val[index.val]?).map (fun record => record.event_id)).getD 0#u64

def Before (dir : Dir) (first second : Int) : Prop :=
  match dir with
  | .Forward => first < second
  | .Backward => second < first

def IndexBefore (dir : Dir) (first second : Usize) : Prop :=
  match dir with
  | .Forward => first.val < second.val
  | .Backward => second.val < first.val

def Valid (snapshot : Snapshot) (index : Usize) : Prop :=
  ∃ record, snapshot.pdus.val[index.val]? = some record ∧ record.outlier = false

def Page (snapshot : Snapshot) (dir : Dir) (start : I64) (xs : List Usize) : Prop :=
  xs.Pairwise (IndexBefore dir) ∧
  ∀ index ∈ xs, Valid snapshot index ∧ Before dir start.val (countAt snapshot index)

theorem page_nil (snapshot : Snapshot) (dir : Dir) (start : I64) : Page snapshot dir start [] := by
  simp [Page]

theorem page_push (snapshot : Snapshot) (dir : Dir) (start : I64) (xs : List Usize) (idx : Usize)
    (hp : Page snapshot dir start xs) (hv : Valid snapshot idx)
    (hr : Before dir start.val (countAt snapshot idx))
    (hb : ∀ old ∈ xs, IndexBefore dir old idx) : Page snapshot dir start (xs ++ [idx]) := by
  constructor
  · simpa [List.pairwise_append] using And.intro hp.1 hb
  · intro old hold
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hold with hold | hold
    · exact hp.2 old hold
    · simpa using (List.mem_singleton.1 hold ▸ And.intro hv hr)

@[step] theorem in_timeline_spec (record : Pdu) (room : U64) :
    svc_timeline.in_timeline record room ⦃ second => second = true → record.outlier = false ⦄ := by
  unfold svc_timeline.in_timeline
  split <;> simp_all

theorem pdus_loop_spec (snapshot : Snapshot) (room : U64) (start : I64) :
    svc_timeline.pdus_loop snapshot room start (alloc.vec.Vec.new Usize) 0#usize
      ⦃ out => Page snapshot .Forward start out.val ⦄ := by
  unfold svc_timeline.pdus_loop
  apply loop.spec_decr_nat
    (measure := fun state => snapshot.pdus.val.length - state.2.val)
    (inv := fun state => Page snapshot .Forward start state.1.val ∧
      state.1.val.length ≤ state.2.val ∧ state.2.val ≤ snapshot.pdus.val.length ∧
      ∀ old ∈ state.1.val, old.val < state.2.val)
  · rintro ⟨out, idx⟩ ⟨hp, hlen, hidx, hbefore⟩
    dsimp at hp hlen hidx hbefore
    unfold svc_timeline.pdus_loop.body
    step*
    have hi : idx.val < snapshot.pdus.val.length := by scalar_tac
    have hv : b = true → Valid snapshot idx := by
      intro hb
      exact ⟨p, by simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, p_post], b_post hb⟩
    have hc : countAt snapshot idx = p.count.val := by
      simp [countAt, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, p_post]
    i5h_steps
    all_goals try scalar_tac
    all_goals simp_all only [WP.spec_ok, Prod.fst, Prod.snd]
    all_goals try
      have hpnew : Page snapshot .Forward start (out.val ++ [idx]) :=
        page_push snapshot .Forward start out.val idx hp (hv trivial)
          (by simp only [Before, hc]; scalar_tac) hbefore
    all_goals simp_all [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton]
    all_goals grind
  · simp [page_nil]

theorem pdus_rev_loop_spec (snapshot : Snapshot) (room : U64) (start : I64) :
    svc_timeline.pdus_rev_loop snapshot.pdus room start (alloc.vec.Vec.new Usize) snapshot.pdus.len
      ⦃ out => Page snapshot .Backward start out.val ⦄ := by
  unfold svc_timeline.pdus_rev_loop
  apply loop.spec_decr_nat
    (measure := fun state => state.2.val)
    (inv := fun state => Page snapshot .Backward start state.1.val ∧
      state.1.val.length + state.2.val ≤ snapshot.pdus.val.length ∧
      ∀ old ∈ state.1.val, state.2.val ≤ old.val)
  · rintro ⟨out, idx⟩ ⟨hp, hlen, hbefore⟩
    dsimp at hp hlen hbefore
    unfold svc_timeline.pdus_rev_loop.body
    step*
    have hi : i1.val < snapshot.pdus.val.length := by scalar_tac
    have hv : b = true → Valid snapshot i1 := by
      intro hb
      exact ⟨p, by simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, p_post], b_post hb⟩
    have hc : countAt snapshot i1 = p.count.val := by
      simp [countAt, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, p_post]
    i5h_steps
    all_goals try
      have hpnew : Page snapshot .Backward start (out.val ++ [i1]) :=
        page_push snapshot .Backward start out.val i1 hp (hv (by assumption))
          (by simp only [Before, hc]; scalar_tac)
          (by intro old hold; simp only [IndexBefore]; have := hbefore old hold; scalar_tac)
    all_goals simp_all [List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton]
    all_goals repeat' constructor
    all_goals first
      | scalar_tac
      | (intro old hold
         by_cases hm : old ∈ out.val
         · have := hbefore old hm; omega
         · simp_all)
  · simp [page_nil]

theorem pdus_ok (snapshot : Snapshot) (room : U64) (start : I64) (outcome)
    (hypothesis : svc_timeline.pdus snapshot room start = ok outcome) :
    match outcome with
    | .Ok out => Page snapshot .Forward start out.val
    | .Err _ => True := by
  unfold svc_timeline.pdus at hypothesis
  obtain ⟨rr, _, hypothesis⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hypothesis
  cases rr with
  | Ok short =>
    obtain ⟨out, hout, hypothesis⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hypothesis
    simp only [ok.injEq] at hypothesis
    subst outcome
    have hp := post_of_ok (pdus_loop_spec snapshot room start) hout
    exact hp
  | Err err =>
    simp only [ok.injEq] at hypothesis
    subst outcome
    trivial

theorem pdus_rev_ok (snapshot : Snapshot) (room : U64) (start : I64) (outcome)
    (hypothesis : svc_timeline.pdus_rev snapshot room start = ok outcome) :

  cases rr with
  | Ok short =>

def entryAt (snapshot : Snapshot) (idx : Usize) : I64 × Usize :=
  (((snapshot.pdus.val[idx.val]?).map (fun record => record.count)).getD 0#i64, idx)

def ToBound (dir : Dir) (upto : Option I64) (count : Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ bound, upto = some bound → Before dir count bound.val

def ScanInv (snapshot : Snapshot) (it : Slice Usize) (dir : Dir) (upto : Option I64)
    (limit : U64) (state : alloc.vec.Vec (I64 × Usize) × Option I64 × Bool × Usize) : Prop :=
  state.2.2.2.val ≤ it.val.length ∧
  state.1.val.Sublist ((it.val.take state.2.2.2.val).map (entryAt snapshot)) ∧
  state.1.val.length ≤ limit.val ∧
  ∀ ent ∈ state.1.val, ToBound dir upto ent.1.val

theorem push_ok {Element : Type} (out out' : alloc.vec.Vec Element) (item : Element)
    (hypothesis : alloc.vec.Vec.push out item = ok out') : out'.val = out.val ++ [item] := by
  unfold alloc.vec.Vec.push at hypothesis
  dsimp only at hypothesis
  split at hypothesis
  · simp only [ok.injEq] at hypothesis
    subst out'
    simp
  · simp at hypothesis

theorem reached_false (upto : Option I64) (dir : Dir) (count : I64)
    (hypothesis : api_message.reached_to upto dir count = ok false) : ToBound dir upto count.val := by
  cases upto with
  | none => simp [ToBound]
  | some bound =>
    cases dir <;> simp [api_message.reached_to, ToBound, Before] at * <;> omega

theorem scan_step (snapshot : Snapshot) (user : U64) (it : Slice Usize) (upto : Option I64)
    (dir : Dir) (limit : U64) (filter : Filter) (short : U64) (bypass : Bool)
    (state : alloc.vec.Vec (I64 × Usize) × Option I64 × Bool × Usize) (outcome)
    (hv : ∀ idx ∈ it.val, Valid snapshot idx) (hx : ScanInv snapshot it dir upto limit state)
    (hypothesis : api_message.scan_loop.body snapshot user it upto dir limit filter short bypass
      state.1 state.2.1 state.2.2.1 state.2.2.2 = ok outcome) :
    match outcome with
    | .done nextState => nextState.1.val.Sublist (it.val.map (entryAt snapshot)) ∧
        nextState.1.val.length ≤ limit.val ∧ ∀ ent ∈ nextState.1.val, ToBound dir upto ent.1.val
    | .cont nextState => ScanInv snapshot it dir upto limit nextState ∧
        (if nextState.2.2.1 then 0 else it.val.length + 1 - nextState.2.2.2.val) <
        (if state.2.2.1 then 0 else it.val.length + 1 - state.2.2.2.val) := by
  rcases state with ⟨events, scanned, done1, idx⟩
  rcases hx with ⟨hi, hsub, hlen, hto⟩
  dsimp at hi hsub hlen hto
  unfold api_message.scan_loop.body at hypothesis
  dsimp only at hypothesis ⊢
  have hwhole := hsub.trans ((List.take_sublist idx.val it.val).map (entryAt snapshot))
  by_cases hd : done1 = true
  · simp only [hd, if_true, ok.injEq] at hypothesis
    subst outcome
    exact ⟨hwhole, hlen, hto⟩
  · simp only [hd, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hypothesis
    by_cases hib : idx < it.len
    · simp only [hib, if_true] at hypothesis
      obtain ⟨len64, hcast, hypothesis⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hypothesis
      have hcastval := post_of_ok (UScalar.cast_inBounds_spec .U64 events.len
        (by have := usize_max_le; scalar_tac)) hcast
      by_cases hlb : len64 < limit
      · simp only [hlb, if_true] at hypothesis
        obtain ⟨pos, hpos, hypothesis⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hypothesis
        obtain ⟨row, hrow, hypothesis⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hypothesis
        obtain ⟨stop, hstop, hypothesis⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hypothesis
        have hidx : idx.val < it.val.length := by scalar_tac
        have hposval := post_of_ok (Slice.index_usize_spec it idx hidx) hpos
        have hvalid := hv pos (hposval ▸ List.getElem_mem hidx)
        obtain ⟨pdu, hget, hout⟩ := hvalid
        have hposbound := (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hget).1
        have hrowval : row = pdu := by
          have hr := post_of_ok (Slice.index_usize_spec snapshot.pdus.slice pos hposbound) hrow
          exact hr.trans (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hget).2
        have hent : entryAt snapshot pos = (row.count, pos) := by
          simp [entryAt, hget, hrowval]
        by_cases hsb : stop = true
        · simp only [hsb, if_true, ok.injEq] at hypothesis
          subst outcome
          simp only [ScanInv, Prod.fst, Prod.snd, hd, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
          exact ⟨⟨hi, hsub, hlen, hto⟩, by omega⟩
        · have hsfalse : stop = false := by cases stop <;> simp_all
          have hbound := reached_false upto dir row.count (hsfalse ▸ hstop)
          simp only [hsb, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at hypothesis
          obtain ⟨passes, _, hypothesis⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hypothesis
          obtain ⟨events', hevents, hypothesis⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hypothesis
          obtain ⟨next, hnext, hypothesis⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hypothesis
          have hn := post_of_ok (by step* : idx + 1#usize ⦃ j => j.val = idx.val + 1 ⦄) hnext
          simp only [ok.injEq] at hypothesis
          subst outcome
          by_cases hpass : passes = true
          · simp only [hpass, if_true] at hevents
            have hpush := push_ok events events' (row.count, pos) hevents
            have htaken : (it.val.take (idx.val + 1)).map (entryAt snapshot) =
                (it.val.take idx.val).map (entryAt snapshot) ++ [(row.count, pos)] := by
              rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hidx, List.map_append, List.map_cons,
                List.map_nil, ← hposval, hent]
            simp only [ScanInv, Prod.fst, Prod.snd, hd, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, hn, hpush]
            refine ⟨⟨by omega, ?_, by scalar_tac, ?_⟩, by omega⟩
            · rw [htaken]
              exact hsub.append (List.Sublist.refl _)
            · intro ent he
              rcases List.mem_append.1 he with he | he
              · exact hto ent he
              · simpa using List.mem_singleton.1 he ▸ hbound
          · simp only [hpass, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, ok.injEq] at hevents
            subst events'
            simp only [ScanInv, Prod.fst, Prod.snd, hd, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, hn]
            refine ⟨⟨by omega, ?_, hlen, hto⟩, by omega⟩
            exact hsub.trans ((List.take_sublist_take_left (by omega)).map (entryAt snapshot))
      · simp only [hlb, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, ok.injEq] at hypothesis
        subst outcome
        exact ⟨hwhole, hlen, hto⟩
    · simp only [hib, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, ok.injEq] at hypothesis
      subst outcome
      exact ⟨hwhole, hlen, hto⟩

theorem countAt_order (snapshot : Snapshot) (hs : Sorted snapshot) (dir : Dir) (first second : Usize)
    (ha : Valid snapshot first) (hb : Valid snapshot second) (hab : IndexBefore dir first second) :
    Before dir (countAt snapshot first) (countAt snapshot second) := by
  obtain ⟨pa, hpa, hoa⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨pb, hpb, hob⟩ := hb
  obtain ⟨hia, hga⟩ := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hpa
  obtain ⟨hib, hgb⟩ := List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hpb
  have hp := List.pairwise_filter.1 hs
  cases dir with
  | Forward =>
    have hc := List.pairwise_iff_getElem.1 hp first.val second.val hia hib hab
    simpa [Before, countAt, hpa, hpb, hga, hgb, hoa, hob] using hc
  | Backward =>
    have hc := List.pairwise_iff_getElem.1 hp second.val first.val hib hia hab
    simpa [Before, countAt, hpa, hpb, hga, hgb, hoa, hob] using hc

theorem scan_ok (snapshot : Snapshot) (user : U64) (it : Slice Usize) (upto : Option I64)
    (dir : Dir) (limit : U64) (filter : Filter) (short : U64) (bypass : Bool)
    (events : alloc.vec.Vec (I64 × Usize)) (scanned : Option I64)
    (hv : ∀ idx ∈ it.val, Valid snapshot idx)
    (hypothesis : api_message.scan snapshot user it upto dir limit filter short bypass = ok (events, scanned)) :
    events.val.Sublist (it.val.map (entryAt snapshot)) ∧ events.val.length ≤ limit.val ∧
      ∀ ent ∈ events.val, ToBound dir upto ent.1.val := by
  unfold api_message.scan api_message.scan_loop at hypothesis
  refine loop_ok
    (fun state => api_message.scan_loop.body snapshot user it upto dir limit filter short bypass
      state.1 state.2.1 state.2.2.1 state.2.2.2)
    (ScanInv snapshot it dir upto limit)
    (fun nextState => nextState.1.val.Sublist (it.val.map (entryAt snapshot)) ∧ nextState.1.val.length ≤ limit.val ∧
      ∀ ent ∈ nextState.1.val, ToBound dir upto ent.1.val)
    (fun state => if state.2.2.1 then 0 else it.val.length + 1 - state.2.2.2.val)
    ?_ _ _ ?_ hypothesis
  · intro state outcome hx hr
    cases outcome <;> exact scan_step snapshot user it upto dir limit filter short bypass state _ hv hx hr
  · simp [ScanInv]

theorem entry_count (snapshot : Snapshot) (idx : Usize) :
    (entryAt snapshot idx).1.val = countAt snapshot idx := by
  unfold entryAt countAt
  cases snapshot.pdus.val[idx.val]? <;> simp

theorem countOf_eventAt (snapshot : Snapshot) (hk : Keys snapshot) (idx : Usize) (hv : Valid snapshot idx) :
    countOf snapshot (eventAt snapshot idx).val = some (countAt snapshot idx) := by
  obtain ⟨record, hget, hout⟩ := hv
  have hmem : record ∈ timeline snapshot := by
    simp only [timeline, List.mem_filter, Bool.not_eq_true]
    exact ⟨List.mem_of_getElem? hget, by simp [hout]⟩
  have hf : (timeline snapshot).find? (fun candidate => candidate.event_id.val = record.event_id.val) = some record := by
    cases he : (timeline snapshot).find? (fun candidate => candidate.event_id.val = record.event_id.val) with
    | none =>
      have := List.find?_eq_none.1 he record hmem
      simp at this
    | some candidate =>
      have hq := I5hLib.find?_mem he
      have hqp : candidate = record := List.inj_on_of_nodup_map hk.1
        (List.mem_of_mem_filter hq.1) (List.mem_of_mem_filter hmem) (by simpa using hq.2)
      simpa [hqp] using he
  simp [countOf, eventAt, countAt, hget, hf]

@[step] theorem event_ids_spec (snapshot : Snapshot) (events : Slice (I64 × Usize))
    (hv : ∀ ent ∈ events.val, Valid snapshot ent.2) :
    api_message.event_ids snapshot events ⦃ out => out.val = events.val.map (fun ent => eventAt snapshot ent.2) ⦄ := by
  unfold api_message.event_ids api_message.event_ids_loop
  have hloop := loop_fold events.val (fun out : alloc.vec.Vec U64 => out.val)
    (fun acc ent => acc ++ [(fun ent : I64 × Usize => eventAt snapshot ent.2) ent])
    (fun out idx => out.val.length ≤ idx)
    (fun state => api_message.event_ids_loop.body snapshot events state.1 state.2)
  apply WP.spec_mono (hloop ?_ (alloc.vec.Vec.new U64) 0#usize (by simp) (by simp))
  · intro out hout
    rw [foldl_map] at hout
    simpa using hout
  · intro out idx hi hlen
    unfold api_message.event_ids_loop.body
    step*
    all_goals try
      have hpos : i2 = events.val[idx.val].2 := congrArg Prod.snd __post
      have hv' := hv events.val[idx.val] (List.getElem_mem (by scalar_tac))
      obtain ⟨pdu, hget, hout⟩ := hv'
      have hidx : i2.val < snapshot.pdus.val.length := by
        rw [hpos]
        exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hget).1
      first
        | exact hidx
        | (have heid : p.event_id = eventAt snapshot i2 := by
             simp only [eventAt, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some]
             rw [← p_post]
           simp only [FoldStep]
           refine ⟨by scalar_tac, ?_, i3_post, by scalar_tac⟩
           simp only [out1_post, heid, hpos])
    all_goals simp_all [FoldStep]
    all_goals try scalar_tac

theorem finish (snapshot : Snapshot) (user : U64) (it : Slice Usize) (upto : Option I64)
    (tok : Token) (dir : Dir) (limit lim : U64) (filter : Filter) (short : U64) (bypass : Bool)
    (start : I64) (events : alloc.vec.Vec (I64 × Usize)) (scanned : Option I64)
    (chunk : alloc.vec.Vec U64) (hk : Keys snapshot) (hs : Sorted snapshot)
    (hp : Page snapshot dir start it.val)
    (hscan : api_message.scan snapshot user it upto dir limit filter short bypass = ok (events, scanned))
    (hids : api_message.event_ids snapshot events.slice = ok chunk)
    (htok : ∀ bound, tok = .At bound → upto = some bound)
    (hlimit : limit.val ≤ min lim.val 1000) :
    ∃ cs : List Int, chunk.val.map (fun event => countOf snapshot event.val) = cs.map some ∧
      (dir = .Forward → cs.Pairwise (· < ·) ∧ ∀ count ∈ cs, start.val < count ∧ ∀ bound, tok = .At bound → count < bound.val) ∧
      (dir = .Backward → cs.Pairwise (· > ·) ∧ ∀ count ∈ cs, count < start.val ∧ ∀ bound, tok = .At bound → bound.val < count) ∧
      chunk.val.length ≤ min lim.val 1000 := by
  have hscan' := scan_ok snapshot user it upto dir limit filter short bypass events scanned
    (fun idx hi => (hp.2 idx hi).1) hscan
  have hent : ∀ ent ∈ events.val, Valid snapshot ent.2 ∧
      ent.1.val = countAt snapshot ent.2 ∧ Before dir start.val ent.1.val := by
    intro ent he
    obtain ⟨idx, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 (hscan'.1.subset he)
    change Valid snapshot idx ∧ (entryAt snapshot idx).1.val = countAt snapshot idx ∧
      Before dir start.val (entryAt snapshot idx).1.val
    simp only [entry_count]
    exact ⟨(hp.2 idx hi).1, trivial, (hp.2 idx hi).2⟩
  have hid := post_of_ok (event_ids_spec snapshot events.slice (fun ent he => (hent ent he).1)) hids
  have hord : events.val.Pairwise (fun first second => Before dir first.1.val second.1.val) := by
    have hiord : it.val.Pairwise (fun first second => Before dir (countAt snapshot first) (countAt snapshot second)) :=
      hp.1.imp_of_mem (fun ha hb hab =>
        countAt_order snapshot hs dir _ _ (hp.2 _ ha).1 (hp.2 _ hb).1 hab)
    have hmord : (it.val.map (entryAt snapshot)).Pairwise
        (fun first second => Before dir first.1.val second.1.val) := by
      apply List.pairwise_map.2
      simpa only [entry_count] using hiord
    exact hmord.sublist hscan'.1
  refine ⟨events.val.map (fun ent => ent.1.val), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hid, List.map_map, List.map_map]
    apply List.map_congr_left
    intro ent he
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, countOf_eventAt snapshot hk ent.2 (hent ent he).1,
      (hent ent he).2.1]
  · intro hd
    subst dir
    refine ⟨List.pairwise_map.2 hord, ?_⟩
    intro count hc
    obtain ⟨ent, he, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hc
    exact ⟨(hent ent he).2.2, fun bound ht => hscan'.2.2 ent he bound (htok bound ht)⟩
  · intro hd
    subst dir
    refine ⟨List.pairwise_map.2 hord, ?_⟩
    intro count hc
    obtain ⟨ent, he, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hc
    exact ⟨(hent ent he).2.2, fun bound ht => hscan'.2.2 ent he bound (htok bound ht)⟩
  · rw [hid, List.length_map]
    exact hscan'.2.1.trans hlimit

theorem bounded_ok (lim out : U64)
    (hypothesis : api_message.bounded (some lim) api_message.LIMIT_DEFAULT api_message.LIMIT_MAX = ok out) :
    out.val ≤ min lim.val 1000 := by
  simp only [api_message.bounded] at hypothesis
  split at hypothesis <;> simp only [ok.injEq] at hypothesis <;> subst out
  all_goals simp only [api_message.LIMIT_MAX] at *
  all_goals scalar_tac

open Lean Elab Tactic Meta in
elab "split_call_result " call:ident : tactic => withMainContext do
  let callName ← realizeGlobalConstNoOverloadWithInfo call
  let goal ← getMainGoal
  let context ← getLCtx
  for decl in context do
    let ty ← whnf decl.type
    if ty.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 then
      let args := ty.getAppArgs
      if args[1]!.isAppOf callName then
        let result := args[2]!.getAppArgs.back!
        if result.isFVar then
          let branches ← goal.cases result.fvarId!
          replaceMainGoal (branches.toList.map (·.mvarId))
          return
  throwError "No call result to split"

open Lean Elab Tactic Meta in
elab "normalize_hypotheses" : tactic => withMainContext do
  let goal ← getMainGoal
  let config ← mkSimpContext (← `(tactic| simp only [ok.injEq, deref_eq_slice])) false
  let (result, _) ← simpGoal goal config.ctx config.simprocs
    (simplifyTarget := false) (fvarIdsToSimp := ← goal.getNondepPropHyps)
  match result with
  | none => replaceMainGoal []
  | some (_, nextGoal) => replaceMainGoal [nextGoal]

macro "invert_run " hypothesis:ident : tactic => `(tactic| (
  repeat' (first
    | (simp (failIfUnchanged := true) only [I5hLib.bind_tc_eq_ok, I5hLib.bind_eq_ok,
        ok.injEq, core.result.Result.Ok.injEq, core.result.Result.Err.injEq,
        Reply.Messages.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, reduceCtorEq, false_and, and_false,
        exists_false, exists_and_left, exists_and_right, exists_eq_left, exists_eq_right,
        Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.true_eq_false, ↓reduceIte, bind_tc_ok, bind_ok,
        _root_.id, id_eq] at $hypothesis:ident)
    | (obtain ⟨_, _, $hypothesis:ident⟩ := $hypothesis)
    | (split at $hypothesis:ident))))

theorem messages_ordered (s : Snapshot) (u room : U64) (frm upto : Token) (dir : Dir) (lim : U64) (f : Filter)
    (st : I64) (en : Option I64) (chunk : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (h : transition s ⟨u, .Messages room frm upto dir lim f⟩ = ok (.Ok (.Messages st en chunk)))
    (hk : Keys s) (hs : Sorted s) :
    ∃ cs : List Int, chunk.val.map (fun e => countOf s e.val) = cs.map some ∧
      (dir = .Forward → cs.Pairwise (· < ·) ∧ ∀ c ∈ cs, st.val < c ∧ ∀ t, upto = .At t → c < t.val) ∧
      (dir = .Backward → cs.Pairwise (· > ·) ∧ ∀ c ∈ cs, c < st.val ∧ ∀ t, upto = .At t → t.val < c) ∧
      chunk.val.length ≤ min lim.val 1000 := by
  unfold transition api_message.get_message_events_route api_message.get_messages at h
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h
  cases frm <;> cases upto <;> cases dir
  all_goals invert_run h
  all_goals split_call_result api_message.scan
  all_goals try dsimp! only at h
  all_goals invert_run h
  all_goals first | split_call_result svc_timeline.pdus | split_call_result svc_timeline.pdus_rev
  all_goals dsimp! only at *
  all_goals normalize_hypotheses
  all_goals injections
  all_goals subst_vars
  all_goals apply finish s u (lim := lim) (filter := f) (hk := hk) (hs := hs)
  all_goals try assumption
  all_goals first
    | exact pdus_ok s room _ (.Ok _) (by assumption)
    | exact pdus_rev_ok s room _ (.Ok _) (by assumption)
    | exact page_nil s _ _
    | exact bounded_ok lim _ (by assumption)
    | (intro bound ht; cases ht <;> rfl)

theorem vec_index_ok {α} {v : alloc.vec.Vec α} {i : Usize} {x : α}
    (h : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice α) v i = ok x) :
    ∃ hb : i.val < v.val.length, x = v.val[i.val] := by
  rw [alloc.vec.Vec.index_slice_index, alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize] at h
  split at h
  · simp at h
  · rename_i y hy
    simp only [ok.injEq] at h; subst h
    have hy2 : v.val[i.val]? = some y := hy
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_some_iff] at hy2
    obtain ⟨hb, he⟩ := hy2
    exact ⟨hb, he.symm⟩

theorem slice_index_ok {α} {v : Slice α} {i : Usize} {x : α}
    (h : Slice.index_usize v i = ok x) :
    ∃ hb : i.val < v.val.length, x = v.val[i.val] := by
  rw [Slice.index_usize] at h
  split at h
  · simp at h
  · rename_i y hy
    simp only [ok.injEq] at h; subst h
    have hy2 : v.val[i.val]? = some y := hy
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_some_iff] at hy2
    obtain ⟨hb, he⟩ := hy2

  · simp at h

theorem usize_add_one_ok {i j : Usize} (h : i + 1#usize = ok j) : j.val = i.val + 1 := by

  exact this.2.1

theorem usize_sub_one_ok {i j : Usize} (h : i - 1#usize = ok j) : j.val = i.val - 1 ∧ 0 < i.val := by

  scalar_tac

def Cond (s : Snapshot) (dir : Dir) (st : I64) (j : Usize) : Prop :=
  ∃ hb : j.val < s.pdus.val.length, s.pdus.val[j.val].outlier = false ∧
    (match dir with
     | .Forward => st.val < s.pdus.val[j.val].count.val
     | .Backward => s.pdus.val[j.val].count.val < st.val)

def Ord' (dir : Dir) (a b : Usize) : Prop :=
  match dir with
  | .Forward => a.val < b.val
  | .Backward => b.val < a.val

def ItOK (s : Snapshot) (dir : Dir) (st : I64) (it : List Usize) : Prop :=
  (∀ j ∈ it, Cond s dir st j) ∧ it.Pairwise (Ord' dir)

theorem pdus_loop_ok (s : Snapshot) (room : U64) (fr : I64) (out : alloc.vec.Vec Usize) (i : Usize)
    (y : alloc.vec.Vec Usize)

  unfold svc_timeline.pdus_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : alloc.vec.Vec Usize × Usize => x.2.val ≤ s.pdus.val.length ∧
      (∀ j ∈ x.1.val, j.val < x.2.val ∧ Cond s .Forward fr j) ∧ x.1.val.Pairwise (Ord' .Forward))
    (fun y => ItOK s .Forward fr y.val) (fun x => s.pdus.val.length - x.2.val) ?_ _ _ hinv h
  rintro ⟨out, i⟩ r ⟨hi, hm, hp⟩ hr
  simp only at hr hi hm hp
  unfold svc_timeline.pdus_loop.body at hr
  i5h_invert hr
  · rename_i hlt p hidx b hb o ho j hj
    obtain ⟨hb', rfl⟩ := vec_index_ok hidx
    have hj' := usize_add_one_ok hj
    simp only [svc_timeline.in_timeline] at hb
    simp only
    refine ⟨⟨by omega, ?_, ?_⟩, by omega⟩
    · split at ho
      · split at ho
        · rw [push_ok ho]
          intro k hk
          rcases List.mem_append.1 hk with hk | hk
          · have := hm k hk; exact ⟨by omega, this.2⟩
          · simp at hk; subst hk
            refine ⟨by omega, hb', ?_, ?_⟩
            · split at hb <;> simp_all
            · simp only; rename_i hc; scalar_tac
        · simp only [ok.injEq] at ho; subst ho
          intro k hk; have := hm k hk; exact ⟨by omega, this.2⟩
      · simp only [ok.injEq] at ho; subst ho
        intro k hk; have := hm k hk; exact ⟨by omega, this.2⟩
    · split at ho
      · split at ho
        · rw [push_ok ho, List.pairwise_append]
          refine ⟨hp, by simp, ?_⟩
          intro a ha b hb2; simp at hb2; subst hb2
          simp only [Ord']; exact (hm a ha).1
        · simp only [ok.injEq] at ho; subst ho; exact hp
      · simp only [ok.injEq] at ho; subst ho; exact hp
  · exact ⟨fun j hj => (hm j hj).2, hp⟩

def NotReached (tt : Option I64) (dir : Dir) (c : I64) : Prop :=
  ∀ t, tt = some t → match dir with
    | .Forward => c.val < t.val
    | .Backward => t.val < c.val

theorem reached_false {tt : Option I64} {dir : Dir} {c : I64}
    (h : api_message.reached_to tt dir c = ok false) : NotReached tt dir c := by
  unfold api_message.reached_to at h
  intro t ht; subst ht
  cases dir <;> simp at h <;> simp only <;> scalar_tac

def EvOK (s : Snapshot) (tt : Option I64) (dir : Dir) (e : I64 × Usize) : Prop :=
  ∃ hb : e.2.val < s.pdus.val.length, e.1 = s.pdus.val[e.2.val].count ∧ NotReached tt dir e.1

theorem scan_ok (s : Snapshot) (user : U64) (it : Slice Usize) (tt : Option I64) (dir : Dir)
    (limit : U64) (filter : Filter) (sh : U64) (bv : Bool) (events : alloc.vec.Vec (I64 × Usize))
    (scanned : Option I64)
    (h : api_message.scan s user it tt dir limit filter sh bv = ok (events, scanned)) :
    (events.val.map (·.2)).Sublist it.val ∧ (∀ e ∈ events.val, EvOK s tt dir e) ∧
      events.val.length ≤ limit.val := by
  unfold api_message.scan api_message.scan_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : alloc.vec.Vec (I64 × Usize) × Option I64 × Bool × Usize =>
      x.2.2.2.val ≤ it.val.length ∧ (x.1.val.map (·.2)).Sublist (it.val.take x.2.2.2.val) ∧
      (∀ e ∈ x.1.val, EvOK s tt dir e) ∧ x.1.val.length ≤ limit.val)
    (fun y : alloc.vec.Vec (I64 × Usize) × Option I64 =>
      (y.1.val.map (·.2)).Sublist it.val ∧ (∀ e ∈ y.1.val, EvOK s tt dir e) ∧
      y.1.val.length ≤ limit.val)
    (fun x => 2 * (it.val.length - x.2.2.2.val) + (if x.2.2.1 then 0 else 1)) ?_ _ _
    (by simp) h
  rintro ⟨evs, sc, dn, i⟩ r ⟨hi, hsub, hm, hlen⟩ hr
  simp only at hr hi hsub hm hlen
  unfold api_message.scan_loop.body at hr
  i5h_invert hr
  · exact ⟨hsub.trans (List.take_sublist _ _), hm, hlen⟩
  · rename_i hdn _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hdn; subst hdn
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    exact ⟨⟨hi, hsub, hm, hlen⟩, by omega⟩
  · rename_i hdn hlt w hw hwl p hp q hq b hb hnr c hc evs' hevs j hj
    simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hdn; subst hdn
    obtain ⟨hpb, rfl⟩ := slice_index_ok hp
    obtain ⟨hqb, rfl⟩ := vec_index_ok hq
    have hj' := usize_add_one_ok hj
    simp only [lift, ok.injEq] at hw; subst hw
    have hwv := usize_cast_u64 evs.len
    simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hnr; subst hnr
    have hnr' := reached_false hb
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
    have hwl' : evs.val.length < limit.val := by
      have : (UScalar.cast UScalarTy.U64 evs.len).val < limit.val := hwl
      rw [hwv] at this; simpa using this
    have htake : List.take j.val it.val = List.take i.val it.val ++ [it.val[i.val]] := by
      rw [hj', List.take_add_one, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hpb]; rfl
    refine ⟨⟨by omega, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, by omega⟩
    · rw [htake]
      split at hevs
      · rw [push_ok hevs, List.map_append]; exact hsub.append (by simp)
      · simp only [ok.injEq] at hevs; subst hevs; exact hsub.trans (List.sublist_append_left _ _)
    · split at hevs
      · rw [push_ok hevs]; intro e he
        rcases List.mem_append.1 he with he | he
        · exact hm e he
        · simp at he; subst he; exact ⟨hqb, rfl, hnr'⟩
      · simp only [ok.injEq] at hevs; subst hevs; exact hm
    · split at hevs
      · rw [push_ok hevs]; simp; omega
      · simp only [ok.injEq] at hevs; subst hevs; exact hlen
  · exact ⟨hsub.trans (List.take_sublist _ _), hm, hlen⟩
  · exact ⟨hsub.trans (List.take_sublist _ _), hm, hlen⟩


theorem event_ids_ok (s : Snapshot) (events : Slice (I64 × Usize)) (chunk : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (h : api_message.event_ids s events = ok chunk) :
    chunk.val.map some = events.val.map (fun e => s.pdus.val[e.2.val]?.map Pdu.event_id) := by
  unfold api_message.event_ids api_message.event_ids_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x : alloc.vec.Vec U64 × Usize => x.2.val ≤ events.val.length ∧
      x.1.val.map some = (events.val.take x.2.val).map (fun e => s.pdus.val[e.2.val]?.map Pdu.event_id))
    (fun y : alloc.vec.Vec U64 =>
      y.val.map some = events.val.map (fun e => s.pdus.val[e.2.val]?.map Pdu.event_id))
    (fun x => events.val.length - x.2.val) ?_ _ _ (by simp) h
  rintro ⟨out, i⟩ r ⟨hi, hout⟩ hr
  simp only at hr hi hout
  unfold api_message.event_ids_loop.body at hr
  i5h_invert hr
  · rename_i hlt w hw
    obtain ⟨c, k⟩ := w
    obtain ⟨hwb, hwe⟩ := slice_index_ok hw
    change (do let p ← alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Pdu) s.pdus k; let out1 ← out.push p.event_id; let i3 ← i + 1#usize; ok (ControlFlow.cont (out1, i3))) = ok r at hr
    i5h_invert hr
    rename_i p hp o ho j hj
    obtain ⟨hpb, rfl⟩ := vec_index_ok hp
    have hj' := usize_add_one_ok hj
    simp only
    refine ⟨⟨by omega, ?_⟩, by omega⟩
    rw [push_ok ho, hj', List.take_add_one, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hwb, List.map_append, hout]
    simp [← hwe, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hpb]
  · rename_i hge
    have : events.val.length ≤ i.val := by scalar_tac
    simp only
    rw [hout, List.take_of_length_le this]


theorem sorted_idx {α} (p : α → Bool) (R : α → α → Prop) : ∀ (L : List α), (L.filter p).Pairwise R →
    ∀ j k (hj : j < L.length) (hk : k < L.length), j < k → p L[j] = true → p L[k] = true → R L[j] L[k] := by
  intro L
  induction L with
  | nil => intro _ j k hj; simp at hj
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro hp j k hj hk hjk hpj hpk
    cases k with
    | zero => omega
    | succ k =>
      cases j with
      | zero =>
        simp only [List.getElem_cons_zero, List.getElem_cons_succ] at hpj hpk ⊢
        rw [List.filter_cons_of_pos hpj, List.pairwise_cons] at hp
        exact hp.1 _ (List.mem_filter.2 ⟨List.getElem_mem _, hpk⟩)
      | succ j =>
        simp only [List.getElem_cons_succ] at hpj hpk ⊢
        have hp' : (t.filter p).Pairwise R := by
          rw [List.filter_cons] at hp
          split at hp
          · exact (List.pairwise_cons.1 hp).2
          · exact hp
        exact ih hp' j k (by simp at hj; omega) (by simp at hk; omega) (by omega) hpj hpk

theorem countOf_eq (s : Snapshot) (hk : Keys s) (j : Nat) (hj : j < s.pdus.val.length)
    (ho : s.pdus.val[j].outlier = false) :
    countOf s s.pdus.val[j].event_id.val = some s.pdus.val[j].count.val := by
  unfold countOf timeline
  have hmem : s.pdus.val[j] ∈ s.pdus.val.filter (fun p => !p.outlier) :=
    List.mem_filter.2 ⟨List.getElem_mem _, by simp [ho]⟩
  cases h : (s.pdus.val.filter (fun p => !p.outlier)).find?
      (fun p => decide (p.event_id.val = s.pdus.val[j].event_id.val)) with
  | none =>
    rw [List.find?_eq_none] at h
    exact absurd (by simp) (h _ hmem)
  | some q =>
    obtain ⟨hq, hpq⟩ := find?_mem h
    have hq' := (List.mem_filter.1 hq).1
    have := List.inj_on_of_nodup_map hk.1 hq' (List.getElem_mem hj) (by simpa using hpq)
    subst this
    rfl

theorem chunk_counts (s : Snapshot) (hk : Keys s) : ∀ (evs : List (I64 × Usize)) (chunk : List U64),
    chunk.map some = evs.map (fun e => s.pdus.val[e.2.val]?.map Pdu.event_id) →
    (∀ e ∈ evs, ∃ hb : e.2.val < s.pdus.val.length, s.pdus.val[e.2.val].outlier = false ∧
      e.1 = s.pdus.val[e.2.val].count) →
    chunk.map (fun e => countOf s e.val) = (evs.map (fun e => e.1.val)).map some := by
  intro evs
  induction evs with
  | nil => intro chunk h _; cases chunk <;> simp_all
  | cons e evs ih =>
    intro chunk h hall
    cases chunk with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons x xs =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.cons.injEq] at h ⊢
      obtain ⟨hb, ho, he⟩ := hall e List.mem_cons_self
      refine ⟨?_, ih xs h.2 (fun e' he' => hall e' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ he'))⟩
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hb, Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at h
      rw [h.1, countOf_eq s hk _ hb ho, he]


theorem core (s : Snapshot) (hk : Keys s) (hs : Sorted s) (dir : Dir) (st : I64)
    (it : alloc.vec.Vec Usize) (hit : ItOK s dir st it.val) (tt : Option I64) (upto : Token)
    (hto : ∀ t, upto = .At t → tt = some t) (limit lim : U64) (hl : limit.val = min lim.val 1000)
    (user : U64) (filter : Filter) (sh : U64) (bv : Bool)
    (events : alloc.vec.Vec (I64 × Usize)) (scanned : Option I64)
    (hsc : api_message.scan s user (alloc.vec.Vec.deref it) tt dir limit filter sh bv = ok (events, scanned))
    (chunk : alloc.vec.Vec U64) (hev : api_message.event_ids s (alloc.vec.Vec.deref events) = ok chunk) :
    ∃ cs : List Int, chunk.val.map (fun e => countOf s e.val) = cs.map some ∧
      (dir = .Forward → cs.Pairwise (· < ·) ∧ ∀ c ∈ cs, st.val < c ∧ ∀ t, upto = .At t → c < t.val) ∧
      (dir = .Backward → cs.Pairwise (· > ·) ∧ ∀ c ∈ cs, c < st.val ∧ ∀ t, upto = .At t → t.val < c) ∧
      chunk.val.length ≤ min lim.val 1000 := by
  obtain ⟨hsub, hevs, hlen⟩ := scan_ok s user _ tt dir limit filter sh bv events scanned hsc
  have hce := event_ids_ok s _ chunk hev
  have hd1 : (alloc.vec.Vec.deref it).val = it.val := by simp [alloc.vec.Vec.deref]
  have hd2 : (alloc.vec.Vec.deref events).val = events.val := by simp [alloc.vec.Vec.deref]
  rw [hd1] at hsub
  rw [hd2] at hce
  have hcond : ∀ e ∈ events.val, Cond s dir st e.2 := fun e he =>
    hit.1 _ (hsub.subset (List.mem_map_of_mem he))
  have hpw : events.val.Pairwise (fun a b => Ord' dir a.2 b.2) :=
    List.pairwise_map.1 (hit.2.sublist hsub)
  refine ⟨events.val.map (fun e => e.1.val), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply chunk_counts s hk _ _ hce
    intro e he
    obtain ⟨hb, ho, _⟩ := hcond e he
    obtain ⟨_, he1, _⟩ := hevs e he
    exact ⟨hb, ho, he1⟩
  · rintro rfl
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [List.pairwise_map]
      refine hpw.imp_of_mem ?_
      intro a b ha hb hab
      obtain ⟨hab', hoa, _⟩ := hcond a ha
      obtain ⟨hbb', hob, _⟩ := hcond b hb
      obtain ⟨_, hea, _⟩ := hevs a ha
      obtain ⟨_, heb, _⟩ := hevs b hb
      rw [hea, heb]
      exact sorted_idx (fun p : Pdu => !p.outlier) (fun a b : Pdu => a.count.val < b.count.val) s.pdus.val hs _ _ hab' hbb'
        hab (by simp [hoa]) (by simp [hob])
    · intro c hc
      obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hc
      obtain ⟨hb, ho, hlt⟩ := hcond e he
      obtain ⟨_, he1, hnr⟩ := hevs e he
      refine ⟨?_, fun t ht => hnr t (hto t ht)⟩
      rw [he1]; exact hlt
  · rintro rfl
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [List.pairwise_map]
      refine hpw.imp_of_mem ?_
      intro a b ha hb hab
      obtain ⟨hab', hoa, _⟩ := hcond a ha
      obtain ⟨hbb', hob, _⟩ := hcond b hb
      obtain ⟨_, hea, _⟩ := hevs a ha
      obtain ⟨_, heb, _⟩ := hevs b hb
      rw [hea, heb]
      exact sorted_idx (fun p : Pdu => !p.outlier) (fun a b : Pdu => a.count.val < b.count.val) s.pdus.val hs _ _ hbb' hab'
        hab (by simp [hob]) (by simp [hoa])
    · intro c hc
      obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hc
      obtain ⟨hb, ho, hlt⟩ := hcond e he
      obtain ⟨_, he1, hnr⟩ := hevs e he
      refine ⟨?_, fun t ht => hnr t (hto t ht)⟩
      rw [he1]; exact hlt
  · have := congrArg List.length hce
    simp only [List.length_map] at this
    omega


theorem uncurry_eq {α β γ} (f : α → β → γ) (x : α × β) : Aeneas.Std.uncurry f x = f x.1 x.2 := by

theorem bounded_ok {lim limit : U64}
    (h : api_message.bounded (some lim) api_message.LIMIT_DEFAULT api_message.LIMIT_MAX = ok limit) :
    limit.val = min lim.val 1000 := by
  simp only [api_message.bounded] at h
  have hm : api_message.LIMIT_MAX.val = 1000 := by unfold api_message.LIMIT_MAX; rfl
  split at h
  · simp only [ok.injEq] at h; subst h; rename_i hl
    have : lim.val < api_message.LIMIT_MAX.val := hl
    omega
  · simp only [ok.injEq] at h; subst h; rename_i hl
    have : ¬ lim.val < api_message.LIMIT_MAX.val := hl
    omega

theorem final (s : Snapshot) (hk : Keys s) (hs : Sorted s) (dir : Dir) (st : I64) (upto : Token)
    (lim : U64) (tt : Option I64) (hto : ∀ t, upto = .At t → tt = some t) (limit : U64)
    (hb : api_message.bounded (some lim) api_message.LIMIT_DEFAULT api_message.LIMIT_MAX = ok limit)
    (it : alloc.vec.Vec Usize) (hit : ItOK s dir st it.val)
    (user : U64) (filter : Filter) (sh : U64) (w : alloc.vec.Vec (I64 × Usize) × Option I64)
    (hsc : api_message.scan s user (alloc.vec.Vec.deref it) tt dir limit filter sh false = ok w)
    (chunk : alloc.vec.Vec U64) (hev : api_message.event_ids s (alloc.vec.Vec.deref w.1) = ok chunk) :
    ∃ cs : List Int, chunk.val.map (fun e => countOf s e.val) = cs.map some ∧
      (dir = .Forward → cs.Pairwise (· < ·) ∧ ∀ c ∈ cs, st.val < c ∧ ∀ t, upto = .At t → c < t.val) ∧
      (dir = .Backward → cs.Pairwise (· > ·) ∧ ∀ c ∈ cs, c < st.val ∧ ∀ t, upto = .At t → t.val < c) ∧
